findings: The approved three-minute quiet interval completed five cases on clean bdea5bd: SLD016/017, PRS017 and PRG007/008, Cocoa/Metal Retina DPR2, no warnings or source/catalog-integrity failures. Mac was released immediately after completion.

Hosted bdea5bd/PR-merge CI passed model conversion/numerics/source quality, full build, photographic Denoise/Sky and unit/integration. Blocking UX returned 203 PASS / 1 FAIL, 87 SKIPPED and 31 NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Supplemental and static steps were skipped, not passed.

The first ZOM001 repetition was killed by the unchanged >5s main-loop watchdog. Its truncated main-thread sample contains only _LUTevalFloat. Both passing sibling samples identify the synchronous test reference -> renderCPU -> DisplayTransform -> cmsDoTransform path; their maximum main-loop gaps were 2678 and 3573 ms.

Source/action ordering and sibling stacks support CPU test-oracle work as the cause, but the failing sample alone does not contain a complete caller chain. The original hosted failure remains retained and the replacement hosted run is required.

Only the independent zoom CPU oracle moves to std::launch::async. ICC data is read on the GUI thread first; workers see immutable fixture/settings/profile data and assert a different thread ID. GUI wait pumps real events. Timeout cancels and joins before borrowed data leaves scope; exceptions propagate.

Pixel math, reference size/ICC, exact acceptance criteria, rendering pipeline, fixtures and watchdog threshold are unchanged. Real GUI heartbeats are never fabricated. Worker start/completion dimensions and elapsed times are logged.
The existing adversarial watchdog test still kills a hung fake process after five seconds and overrides its forged PASS. This is a runner unit control, not a real application hang scenario.
limits: Native evidence predates the worker-only harness change; no second native interval was assumed or used.
Offscreen timing on this M3 is not a product latency or hosted-runner performance qualification. CPU references remain independent of the application backend and do not prove GPU completion order.
No claim closes GAP049, BUG045, full phase coverage, load/hardware/model/RAW/installation or updater gaps. Stable distribution remains 0.5.1 and no 1.0 tag/appcast/installer is published.
